qualification: The original adapter and CLI were read with git show at the exact source into temporary same-depth files within this experiment. The identical hostile test and customer-control files ran against that CLI with CW18_EVIDENCE_CLI; temporary baseline files were then removed. This avoids treating existing fixtures or tests as the oracle.

limits: Input records and feedback are unsigned local files, not independently authenticated evidence. Coherent forgeries are outside this offline adapter.
No production acceptance, external buyer, settled revenue, live RPC, deployment or payment was tested or claimed.
Customer regression has 7 explicit skips: 1 opt-in production preflight and 6 mounted-runtime checks without merchant dependencies. Full merchant suite was not run.
V2 export intentionally changes privacy fields and restricts compilePortableEvidence to immutable joined records.
Retained body checks reuse the supplied customer contract; original wire/media type and original policy provenance are unavailable.
Transaction deduplication is conservative without a unique transfer log index, and applies within an export only.
Digest redaction preserves correlation and is not protection against guessing.
